references.text: Jesus' words to those who did not believe in him confirm that the lack of faith among his closest relatives (such as his brothers) is a sign that they do not belong to his flock.
Describes a similar conflict where many believed in Jesus but did not confess it for fear of the religious leaders, reflecting the skepticism his brothers had shown earlier.
Clarifies that Jesus' brothers, who previously did not believe, were later gathered with the disciples and "continued in prayer," marking a complete shift from skepticism to faith.
